Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
High-value items
## [DWM-3] High-value items Claims for items worth more than ₹10,000 are handled by the Priority Resolution team. The support agent must create a ticket and hand over; the agent cannot approve these claims.

Delivery and shipping policy
Late deliveries
## [DEL-4] Late deliveries If an **Express** order arrives after its promised date, the ₹79 express fee the customer paid is credited to ZentroMart Wallet automatically within 48 hours. ZentroMart Plus members, who pay no express fee, get no credit. There is no compensation for late Standard deliveries. Agents must not offer any other compensation.

About this knowledge base
Today's date
## [KB-00.2] Today's date All records in this dataset are frozen on **20 October 2026**. Treat this date as "today" when you calculate deadlines, delays and refund timelines.

Escalation and human handover
When to hand over to a human
## [ESC-1] When to hand over to a human Hand over at once when any of these is true: 1. **Damaged, defective or wrong item worth more than ₹10,000.** 2. **Customer reports an order, payment or account activity they did not make.** 3. **Customer mentions legal action, a consumer court or a police complaint.** 4. **Third or later contact about the same issue within 7 days.** 5. **Refund more than 3 business days past its maximum timeline.** 6. **Customer asks for a human agent.** 7. **Product safety risk such as a swelling battery, burning smell, sparks or injury.** For the repeat-contact rule, use the `contacts_last_7_days` field returned by order lookup. It counts earlier contacts only, not the current one. Escalate when it is 2 or more.

About this knowledge base
Business days
## [KB-00.3] Business days A business day is Monday to Saturday, excluding the warehouse holidays below. Refund and logistics timelines are counted in business days. Return windows are counted in calendar days. | Date | Holiday | | --- | --- | | 2026-08-15 | Independence Day | | 2026-10-02 | Gandhi Jayanti | | 2026-10-19 | Warehouse closure (festival) | | 2026-11-09 | Warehouse closure (festival) |

Damaged, wrong or missing items policy
Resolution
## [DWM-2] Resolution After verification the customer gets a free replacement or a full refund, including delivery fees. No reverse pickup fee applies.

Escalation and human handover
What to do first
## [ESC-2] What to do first Create a ticket with `create_ticket` before handing over. Tell the customer a human colleague will contact them, and never promise an outcome, amount or time beyond what a policy states.

Escalation and human handover
Things you must never do
## [ESC-4] Things you must never do - Promise compensation, refunds or exceptions that a policy does not allow. - Say an action is done unless the tool call succeeded. - Share another customer's details.
